name: Superorder
oneLiner: AI agent platform for restaurant chains (formerly Forward Kitchens) covering review management, surveys and guest feedback, delivery profitability, scorecards and alerts.
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant brands with significant delivery and takeout volume that want AI-written review replies across Google, Yelp and delivery apps, plus feedback flows that win back unhappy guests.

updates.text: L&L Hawaiian Barbecue partnered with Superorder to improve guest engagement and feedback collection across its 230+ locations.

features: Review Management Agent that pulls reviews from Google, Yelp and delivery platforms into one dashboard
AI-written review replies personalized with the guest's order details
Surveys & Feedback Agent that collects private feedback after orders
Automated recovery offers sent to dissatisfied guests
Delivery profitability agents for third-party delivery operations
AI scorecards comparing performance across locations
Insights and real-time alerts on guest issues

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Superorder does not publish prices. Contact the company for a quote.

notes: Renamed from Forward Kitchens in 2023, when it raised a $10M Series A led by Foundation Capital (TechCrunch, Sep 2023). It has since moved from a delivery/takeout operating system and virtual storefronts to AI agents for reputation and delivery profitability. The current review's mention of 'online ordering' as part of the platform reflects the older positioning; the current product pages emphasize review, feedback and delivery-profitability agents, so leave online ordering out. The L&L partnership appears on superorder.com/press; the July 2025 date comes from a third-party company profile (yespress.io/superorder) and could not be confirmed on the press page itself. Wow Bao and Marco's Pizza are listed as restaurant partners on Superorder's Y Combinator profile, not in published case studies. Dropped vendor stats: 'won back 21% of unhappy customers' (Tasty Restaurant Group case study headline, vendor claim) and 'revisit rates up 20%' (third-party listing). No 2026 product announcements found.
